thread:
jia: Quick spike idea — route tier=starter traffic in EU to cheaper quantized variants (eg q4_8) by default, and only fallback to fp16 when quality checks fail or latency SLOs are violated. Want feedback on API/console UX + telemetry before I spin up a canary next week.

omar: Sounds good. Two concerns: 1) how do we express this in the routing policy DSL (should be explicit: region + customer_tier -> variant preference), 2) how do we measure/regress quality so we don't silently degrade?

maria: For token controls I'd add both per-request caps and rolling rate limits. Starter tier could get max_tokens=1024 and a daily token quota. Enforce at the gateway so cheaper variants can't be gamed.

kevin: Telemetry things we need out of the box: tokens_in, tokens_out, model_variant, estimated_cost, latency_ms, and a quality_signal boolean from evals (matches_on_holdout_prompts). Also expose an aggregate cost-per-req metric by tier+region so product can see savings.

omar: Proposal for routing DSL snippet:
```json
{
  "match": {"region":"eu","customer_tier":"starter"},
  "variants": [{"name":"gpt4-q4_8","weight":0.9, "role":"primary"},
               {"name":"gpt4-fp16","weight":0.1, "role":"fallback","conditions":{"quality_drop_pct":5}}],
  "token_controls": {"max_tokens":1024, "monthly_quota": 1000000}
}
```

jia: Nice. Two UX asks: show estimated $/month savings for the selected routing rule in the console, and surface a simple "rollback on quality regression" toggle with threshold sliders.

kevin: For quality signal we can compute a rolling similarity score vs a curated prompt set and fire a regression alert if average similarity drops > X or hallucination rate increases. We'll need to store per-variant sample outputs for quick diffs.

maria: Also need to be careful with region-specific legal flags — EU customers may require different logging/KMS rules. The routing rule must be composable with privacy controls (eg no persistent logs for certain customers).

omar: Operationally: canary plan — start at 5% traffic for 24h, collect cost + quality metrics, then 25% for 48h, auto-increase if no regressions. Rollback criteria: latency P95 > SLO or quality_delta_ppts > 3 on holdout set.

deploy-bot: canary started: rule=starter-eu-q4, pct=5, started_by=jia

jia: Action items: (1) eng-platform to add "variant_preference" + token_controls fields to routing API (omar, kevin), (2) telemetry to add per-variant cost and quality metrics (kevin), (3) console to show estimated savings + rollback toggle (maria), (4) privacy/region checks (maria). I'll open PRs and a canary ticket.

omar: SGTM. Let's also add a lightweight audit event whenever a fallback to fp16 happens so sales/customer success can triage complaints.

kevin: I'll prototype the metrics panel tomorrow. If anyone has a small list of holdout prompts for starter tier, drop them here and I'll wire the similarity checks.

jia: dropping 8 prompts now in #eng-platform-assets. Thanks all :thumbsup:
